tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm paper in light, warm night in dark. Feeds and posts sit directly on it, edge to edge.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card fill and the fill of text fields.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, dialogs, bottom sheets and the neutral toast.

tokens.name: nav-surface
tokens.usage: The blurred navigation island specified by the design. Not shipped yet: it needs expo-blur, so the app uses nav-surface-solid.

tokens.name: nav-surface-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of the floating navigation island and the docked bottom bar. Alpha value: applied with style, it has no Tailwind class.

tokens.name: nav-label
tokens.usage: Unselected navigation labels and icons on nav-surface-solid.

tokens.name: nav-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around the navigation island and above the docked bar.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: The capsule behind the selected navigation item.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Received chat bubbles, avatar and group fallbacks, pressed and hovered rows, disabled filled controls, the empty-state icon tile.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink: all body copy, titles and default icons on background, card, muted and surface-raised. Also the fill of a selected chip.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Meta lines, timestamps, hints, placeholders and empty-state descriptions on background, card and muted.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Volcanic Orange. A fill only: the one main button of a screen, your own chat bubbles, the Create tile, the send button, the tab underline and the wordmark's dot. Never text.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary in both themes (ink, never white).

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary fills while pressed or hovered.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Orange you read: ghost and link buttons, Show more, inline actions on background and card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm tint: highlighted cards and the accent avatar and group fallback.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Initials and icons on accent.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary badge fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and menu outlines, the bottom-sheet handle. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: The rule under each post and under the segmented tabs.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of text fields, outline buttons and chips (3:1 on background and card).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px border of a focused field and the focus-visible outline on web (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Alias of focus kept for components ported from React Native Reusables.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Static loading placeholders. No shimmer.

tokens.name: disabled-foreground
tokens.usage: Label and icon of a disabled filled or outlined control, on muted.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and badge outlines on background, card and success-surface. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Success toast fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and badge outlines on background, card and warning-surface.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Warning banner fill.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (text only, inside menus and dialogs), error text, invalid field borders, on background, card, surface-raised and destructive-surface.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill (the destructive badge).

tokens.name: destructive-surface
tokens.usage: Error toast fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on background, card and info-surface.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Informational banner fill.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, menus and bottom sheets. Alpha value: applied with style.

tokens.name: wordmark
tokens.usage: Letters of the Penguin wordmark; its dot is primary.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Text h2. Screen titles in the top bar.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Text h3. Sheet, dialog and empty-state titles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Text h4. Section headers, card titles, titles after Back.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your thoughts, questions, and discoveries belong here.
styles.usage: Default text: posts, messages, field input.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.usage: Arabic (right-to-left) posts and messages: a size up and taller lines.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Check your connection and try again.
styles.usage: Dialog and empty-state descriptions, toast messages.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, names (Text large) and menu items (menu items at 400).

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Text muted: meta lines in muted-foreground.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, errors under fields, message times, day labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Navigation labels (600 when selected) and badges.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale, limited to these steps. Screen gutter is space-5.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps in navigation and badges; padding after a Back button.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and between chat bubble and avatar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a post, a dialog and an empty state; menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between message groups, toast padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter: posts, top bar title inset, sheet content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, empty-state side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Largest step: section breaks on auth and onboarding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Row height (conversation, group, student rows) and the empty-state icon circle.

tokens.name: radius-beak
tokens.usage: The one tight corner that points at the source: the last bubble of a group, the Create tile and the send button. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls and media: buttons, fields, cards, group avatars (48), menu items, skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The three soft corners of the 48px Create tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, bottom sheets (top corners), dialogs, menus, toasts, group avatars (96).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The pill-shaped chat composer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, chips, icon buttons, the navigation island and its capsule. Circles are students; groups are rounded squares.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, badges, dividers, the navigation island.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outlines of fields, outline buttons and chips.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused or invalid field border, web focus outline, selected-tab underline, Profile tab avatar ring.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; compact controls restore it with hitSlop.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Button height; also fields and icon buttons.

tokens.name: button-compact
tokens.usage: Button size sm (header actions).

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Single-line text field height; multiline starts at 112px.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Chip height.

tokens.name: tab
tokens.usage: Segmented tab height.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Top bar height below the status bar inset.

tokens.name: header-chat
tokens.usage: Chat header height.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Navigation item height.

tokens.name: nav-max-width
tokens.usage: Widest the floating navigation island gets.

tokens.name: nav-inset-x
tokens.usage: Side inset of the floating island.

tokens.name: nav-offset-bottom
tokens.usage: Gap between the island and the bottom inset.

tokens.name: create-tile
tokens.usage: The orange Create tile in the navigation.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: List row height.

tokens.name: content-max-width
tokens.usage: Max width of feed and form content on tablets and web.

tokens.name: avatar-xs
tokens.usage: Search meta and the Profile tab.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Beside received chat bubbles.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Posts, comments, chat header.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Rows and tiles.

tokens.name: avatar-xl
tokens.usage: Profile header.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Meta icons and field error icons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Post actions and field icons (default).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Navigation, headers and toolbars.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Empty-state icon tile.

shadow.note: Only floating layers cast a shadow. Android uses elevation 6 (raised) and 12 (sheet) instead.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Navigation island, menus, dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.
